Description: A fist-sized stone slug formed in the palm and fired instantly - no incantation. Cheap, fast and light: the chantless mage's jab.

Rudeus's signature spell: a dense, bullet-shaped stone driven at extreme velocity. Hold to compress and accelerate it (up to 1.6 s): a fully charged shot flies 1.8x faster and hits 2.2x harder with 2.5x stagger, at double the mana. The charge pose is deliberately readable even with chantless casting.

A Water + Earth combination spell that turns the ground into deep mud. Enemies inside move at 55% speed, accelerate and jump poorly and dodge half as far - but are never rooted. Earth projectiles hitting a mired target land more reliably. The spell behind Rudeus's epithet, 'Quagmire'.

Four chantless spells in under a second - stone, wind blade, water cannon, fire burst - each with a different flight and hit profile. Rudeus can drift at 35% speed while casting. Gameplay-original showcase of his multi-element versatility.
Barrage step 1. Heavy, slower stone slug on a straight line; high stagger to open the target up.
Barrage step 2. A very fast, wide and thin crescent of wind with a slight sine drift - low damage, hard to sidestep, clips several enemies standing in a line.
Barrage step 3. Fast, pressurised water jet with strong knockback (900) and moderate damage - resets spacing.
Barrage step 4. Fast fire bolt that bursts in a small 220 cm explosion on impact.

The Demon Eye of Foresight, a gift from the Demon Empress Kishirika Kishirisu. Pouring mana into it lets Rudeus glimpse a moment ahead: for 10 s incoming attacks appear as predictive silhouettes before they land. It shows the future - it does not make him faster or tougher.

Rudeus stops holding back. After a 1.8 s transformation (interruptible by nothing, but he takes damage normally) he casts 30% faster for 30% less mana, his zones grow 35%, projectiles fly 15% faster and the Demon Eye sees 0.25 s further ahead. Stone Cannon and Quagmire are replaced by empowered versions. NOT invincible.
Awakened Stone Cannon: heavier, faster slug that charges in 1.4 s. Full charge hits 2.3x harder with 2.6x stagger. Still shows a clear charge pose.
Awakened Quagmire: deeper, longer-lasting mud (10 s). 45% move speed, very poor acceleration/jump/dodge - still never a root. Awakening's area bonus makes it 35% wider.
A short, economical open-palm strike from the Dragon God Style - almost no wasted motion and no mana. Hits everything in a small 120 cm cone in front of him.

A counter-spell of the Dragon God Style (devised by the former Dragon God Urupen): Orsted sends out mana tuned to interfere with an enemy spell so it scatters before it can form. Timing-based - a 0.35 s window within 450 cm. If nothing arrives he is left open for 0.45 s. Not permanent immunity.

A single gliding step that closes up to 900 cm toward the target in 0.18 s and lands a short palm. The launch frame comes 0.08 s after input and he is NOT invulnerable during the step; 0.3 s recovery on arrival.
Awakened Dragon Step: 1100 cm in 0.16 s, 2.2 s cooldown, slightly heavier arrival strike. Still not invulnerable.

The ultimate technique of the Dragon God Style: a dense battle aura that turns aside most spells and blades. For 12 s Orsted takes 20% less damage, 15% less magic damage and 50% less stagger, and weak foes within 500 cm falter and are pushed back by the pressure. Costs precious mana.

Orsted fights as the Dragon God for 25 s after a 1.5 s transformation: 25% faster startup, +0.12 s on counter windows, 15% damage and 40% stagger resistance, 20% longer dashes, and an upgraded Dragon Step. Not invincible - his mana still barely recovers.
A burst of wind carries the caster 650 cm in any input direction. Mobility, not a dodge: no invulnerability.
Catch your breath mid-fight: instantly recover 40 stamina and 50 poise, then for 6 s shrug off 20% of incoming stagger and move 5% faster. Small, reliable, human.
A human pushes past their limits for 15 s: +15% damage and 30% stagger resistance. Modest by design.
Inspired by Migurd telepathy: a silent mental pulse that 'hears' hostile intent within 1500 cm, revealing enemies and their incoming attacks (foresight) for 3 s.
The caster's mana resonates like a Migurd choir for 15 s: spells cost 25% less and cast 10% faster.
A low, explosive lunge of 550 cm toward the target with a raking strike on arrival. Not invulnerable.
Senses sharpen and the body follows for 15 s: +15% movement speed, 20% longer dashes and 0.15 s earlier warning of incoming attacks.
The red jewel on a Superd's forehead perceives living beings and the flow of mana: reveals enemies within 2000 cm, even behind cover, and their incoming attacks for 5 s.
The feared Superd warrior spirit for 15 s: +15% damage, 30% stagger resistance, +0.05 s counter windows.
Elves are famed archers and mages: a fast, straight arrow of condensed wind mana.
Draws on the long-lived elves' deep mana for 15 s: spells cost 20% less and zones are 15% wider.
Brace like a mountain for 5 s: 20% damage and 25% stagger resistance, but 15% slower.
A smith's fire in the chest for 15 s: +10% damage, 15% damage and 30% stagger resistance.
Hardens dragon-tribe scales for 4 s: 25% damage and 15% magic resistance.
The Dragon Tribe's battle aura flares for 15 s: +15% damage, 15% damage and 35% stagger resistance.
Immortal flesh knits back together: for 3 s take 30% less damage and 50% less stagger while the body reassembles.
Embraces immortal-demon resilience for 15 s: regenerate 15 HP/s, 20% damage and 40% stagger resistance, +10% damage.
A slow, heavy two-handed slam (0.55 s wind-up) that hits everything within 300 cm with big stagger.
Ogre might unleashed for 15 s: +20% damage and 35% stagger resistance, 5% slower.
Rides a surge of water 600 cm in any direction. Not invulnerable.
The sea's favour for 15 s: spells cost 15% less, 15% magic resistance, +10% movement speed.
Quick snapping bite. Short range, light stagger.
Crouches (0.5 s tell) then leaps 450 cm at the target.
Clumsy overhead club swing.
Lobs a rock in a visible arc. Physical, not magic: Disturb Magic cannot cancel it.
A trained diagonal sword cut.
A chanted fire bolt - the long, audible incantation is the tell. Disruptable.
A long howl (0.9 s, punishable): for 8 s the alpha deals 20% more damage, resists 20% stagger and moves 10% faster.
Coils then pounces 700 cm; long recovery if it misses.
A big forward claw rake with a raised-foreleg tell.
Winds up (1.0 s) and sweeps its tail through a full 360 degrees.
Rears back and scorches a line in front of it: ground marks appear 0.8 s before the flames erupt in four pulses. Physical breath, not a spell.
Takes off (1.2 s tell) and crashes down along a 1600 cm line; long recovery on landing.
A single downward strike with the full weight of the Dragon God behind it. The ground splits, a shockwave rolls outward and rubble is thrown into the air. No light, no colour: just force.
Flames spiral together above the palm into a compressed, white-hot sphere that bursts on impact and scorches the ground.
A sweep of the arm sends a wide wall of fire rolling across the ground, burning everything it passes through and leaving the grass scorched.
A burning magic circle blooms under the target. After a heartbeat of warning, pillars of fire erupt through it and a flame vortex climbs into the sky.
Water gathers in front of the caster, compresses into a dense sphere and fires with enough force to knock a grown man flat.
Water spirals upward into the shape of a dragon that hunts the target down and crashes into it in a huge splash and shockwave.
Water wells up across a wide front and breaks into a wave that rolls forward, sweeping enemies away and soaking the ground.
A swing of the hand releases a thin blade of compressed air: almost invisible, betrayed only by the dust it drags and the distortion at its edge.
The air starts turning around a single point, then tears upward into a tornado that drags dust, leaves and enemies in and hurls them around.
Compressed air bursts out of the caster in rings, flattening the grass and throwing nearby enemies back.
Rock forms above the hand, compresses and spins up before launching at tremendous speed. Hold to compress it further.
The ground cracks and thick slabs of stone burst upward, shedding dirt and rubble. The walls physically block attacks.
Cracks race across the ground toward the target and stone spikes erupt one after another in their wake.
The four formations collapse into one orb of earth, water, fire and wind that bursts in every element at once.
